text: dsh-wechat-shot 在 DSH 聊天输入框左侧提供剪刀按钮，可冻结桌面并拖动框选区域；选区可移动或缩放，确认后将 PNG 作为图片附件加入当前草稿，也复制到剪贴板。支持保留当前窗口或选择隐藏窗口截图，并可用 Enter 确认、Esc 或右键取消。插件通过桌面客户端界面与 Host 路由配合完成截图。

dsh-wechat-shot adds a scissors button to the DSH composer. Select and adjust a screen region, then confirm to add its PNG as a draft image attachment. You can keep the DSH window visible or hide it during capture. Enter confirms; Escape or right click cancels.
How can I select part of my screen and attach it to my DSH message draft?
Can I take a screenshot without including the DSH window?
Can I cancel a screen capture without adding an image?
dsh-wechat-shot adds the captured PNG to the current session draft through the composer attachment API.
dsh-wechat-shot runs on Windows with PowerShell 5.1 and WinForms; macOS and Linux are unsupported.
